admission: A fix is backported now, as an admitted patch with its own failing-without-the-fix tests and a gate record, only when it is reachable in the configuration charmer renders and it protects stored credentials or the availability of sign-in or API-key routes. Everything else is carried by the rebase onto the 8.x line or needs no action.
rendered_configuration: listener on 127.0.0.1 only, every client authenticated by the gateway API key
plugins.enabled false, Home off, discovery off, pprof off
logging-to-file false and no request-log key (request logging off; error logs of failed requests are still forced)
disable-cooling true for every credential, no request-scoped error rules, no per-credential or per-provider cooling override
management only through the environment key and the read-only allowlist on the Nix channel, otherwise off
request-retry 0, max-retry-credentials 1, fill-first routing; one auto-refresh loop per process with 16 workers

fixes.subject: fix(logging): prevent request log collisions and select latest log by ID
fixes.reason: Reachable for the forced error logs of failed requests, but it concerns two log files with one name, not stored credentials or route availability; the read-only management allowlist refuses log retrieval.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): isolate credential-scoped quota cooldown from model quota state
fixes.reason: Not reachable: every change sits behind cooling being enabled, and the rendered disable-cooling true applies to every credential (no request-scoped force-cooldown rule, no cooling override). Upstream's regression tests fail on the pinned tree with cooling enabled; the same model-only plus credential-scoped 429 sequence under the rendered setting leaves no credential or model deadline.

fixes.subject: feat(pluginhost): add host http operation bridge and lifecycle scoping
fixes.reason: Not reachable: plugins are disabled, so no plugin stream, callback or instance exists.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve file priority across plugin auth refreshes
fixes.reason: Not reachable: the refresh path it fixes runs only through plugin auth adapters (plugins are disabled); its management hunk is refused by the read-only allowlist.

fixes.subject: fix(api): immediately close connections on stop and guard state access
fixes.reason: Partial backport, re-reviewed 2026-10-07: only Service.Run creates the existing 30-second shutdown context inside its defer, so its budget starts on exit. The same local patch independently joins in-flight refresh workers through durable save and receipt reporting; atomic replacement alone prevents torn files, not loss of a rotated token. The listener-locking and immediate HTTP connection-closing changes remain deferred to rebase; HTTP graceful draining is unchanged. A live v7* tag check found v7.3.20 (ef9e71201e0ca72b03a540d9b6e0862f8c053347) latest, and its 43-commit comparison from v7.3.15 contains no smaller worker-join fix. This bounded wait does not guarantee persistence after a crash, SIGKILL, filesystem failure or a stop-budget overrun.

fixes.subject: fix(session): avoid rescanning large payloads during session extraction
fixes.reason: CPU hardening for large request bodies; requests come only from local clients holding the gateway API key, and no credential or route state is involved.

fixes.subject: fix(interceptors): avoid cloning request body for read-only interceptors
fixes.reason: Resource change with shared-buffer semantics that overlap the keyed-safety and interceptor patches; it needs an ownership audit, not a security backport.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): preserve attributes and path across plugin refreshes
fixes.reason: The plugin refresh part is not reachable (plugins are disabled). The watcher retry matters only when a credential path is missing for more than the 50 ms replace check; every credential writer here (sign-in and refresh saves) replaces the file by an atomic rename, so the path never disappears.

fixes.subject: fix(auth): unschedule disabled invalid_grant credentials and apply exponential backoff for enabled invalid_grant
fixes.reason: The disabled-credential part is not reachable: a credential is disabled only by a disabled field in its file or by a management write, charmer writes neither and the allowlist refuses management writes. For an enabled credential it changes only how often a refresh that already failed with invalid_grant is retried (every 5 minutes on the pinned release, 1 minute doubling to 30 minutes upstream); it restores no route and protects no stored credential.

fixes.reason: New plugin scheduler contract; plugins are disabled.

fixes.subject: feat(codex): support Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC)
fixes.reason: SIWC credentials need a SIWC sign-in or --siwc-bind, and charmer runs neither. But the change rewrites the Codex refresh and persist path for every Codex OAuth credential: PersistCodexAuthFile (sdk/cliproxy/auth/codex_persist.go:35-130) takes <path>.lock (internal/auth/codex/filelock_unix.go:12), merges with disk and writes via WriteJSONFileAtomic (internal/auth/codex/token.go:58), which renames without fsync. Consequences: the credential-save-report rewrite must make all three branches durable and emit credential_save_v1; credentialed redirects extend to siwc_auth.go and openai_auth.go; loopback-oauth re-anchors codex/oauth_server.go; and charmer must keep ignoring .lock names.

fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag: Server.cfgMu/getConfig, BaseAPIHandler.runtimeMu/CurrentConfig and the watcher configApplyMu. About 25 call sites still re-read CurrentConfig, for example handlers.go:635 and handlers_errors.go:131. plugin-host-locking is dropped (L0 decision).

fixes.subject: Claude preserved-thinking block binding (thinking-binding-controls beta), adaptive synthesis, between_tools disable type and registry thinking facts
fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag and changes native Claude Code requests. On opus-5-5, sonnet-5-5, haiku-5-5 and fable-5-1, a history with signed thinking gets thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior=drop_block plus the beta, in every fingerprint mode. Disabled thinking becomes between_tools or low adaptive wherever the registry now says zero_allowed false: ad9e456d sets that for claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5-1 and claude-opus-5-5, and removes budget min/max on fable-5, fable-5-1 and opus-4-8. This turns 400s into served requests (#6697, #6698). L4 records them as named exact-client deltas and re-proves the effort, thinking and Kimi filter-thinking contracts. No payload filter, because it would bring the 400s back.

fixes.subject: feat(auth): prevent stale file snapshots from overwriting later persisted state
fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag and meets the admission rule on stored credentials: an unversioned file-synthesised snapshot can no longer overwrite a later persisted credential (#6709). The serve-after-initial-auth-load and credential-save-report ports follow its digest-bound snapshots (internal/watcher/dispatcher.go, synthesizer/file.go, conductor_lifecycle.go).

fixes.subject: fix(logging): escape request path in access log to prevent log injection
fixes.reason: Admitted cherry-pick (access-log integrity). It ships verbatim with its test as series patch cli-proxy-api-access-log-path-quoting.patch in the 8.0.33 rebase, and becomes backport with that patch name when the pin moves. Reachable: every request, authenticated or not, is access-logged, and %0A in the path splits the line (#6731). It protects the persistence-hold evidence that gates gateway stops and restarts. Applies cleanly to v8.0.33; port size unchanged (144/139).

fixes.subject: feat(auth): increase Codex proactive refresh lead to 96 hours and improve rejected token handling
fixes.reason: Admitted as a partial cherry-pick, shipped as cli-proxy-api-codex-refresh-lead.patch. Only the 96 h CodexOuterRefreshLead is taken: sdk/auth/codex.go RefreshLead, plus the constant and the codex default in sdk/cliproxy/auth/types.go. Meets the admission rule: Codex OAuth refresh runs in the rendered loop, and with a 24 h lead, tokens invalidated about 7 days after issue stay selected under disable-cooling + fill-first (#6742, open). The existing refresh-on-401 in conductor_execution.go and conductor_stream.go does not prevent this. The rejected-token half (credential-scoped 401 in MarkResult, scheduler blocking of expired tokens, markRejectedAccessToken) changes selection for every OAuth provider, including Claude. It is under a day old and unsoaked, so it waits for the next re-pin.

fixes.subject: feat(watcher): protect credentials from unindexed deletion during incomplete or in-place file writes
fixes.reason: Not admitted; arrives with the next re-pin. Not reachable: the full-scan window needs an in-place auth-file writer (#6734). After the credential-save-report rewrite, every gateway save stages and renames, including the Codex branch. Management writes are refused. charmer itself writes the auth directory only while the gateway is stopped (snapshot restore, proxy.py:1375). The commit is a 700-line watcher change that overlaps the watcher-parentdir and serve-after-initial-auth-load ports. The credential-save-report rewrite adds the test that keeps it unreachable: no O_TRUNC write to an existing credential path.

fixes.subject: feat(auth): snapshot plugin scheduler and release host lock during executor registration
fixes.reason: Fixes #6744 (ABBA deadlock), which needs plugin records. With plugins disabled the host snapshot is empty, and activeRecordsFromSnapshot returns before Host.mu is taken (internal/pluginhost/snapshot.go:57-60), so credential selection never takes the host lock.
